concerns.text: Performance test task T061 (NFR‑001) lacks concrete hardware and runtime thresholds, leaving the non‑functional requirement that 10 1080p images be processed in <30 s unverified. This weakens FR‑001/NFR‑001 because the specification demands a measurable performance guarantee.

Task T066 is marked as ‘Resolve Performance Benchmark Details’ but remains unresolved, meaning the exact CPU model, core count, and baseline runtime are not defined. Without these details the performance constraint cannot be enforced, constituting a weakening of the required NFR‑001.
Task T061b (RAM test) also lacks concrete memory limits (the spec requires < 2 GB). The unresolved claim means the RAM aspect of NFR‑001 is not satisfied, weakening the functional guarantee.
Task T067 (Resolve RAM Limit Details) remains unresolved, so the RAM‑usage threshold is never concretized. This again weakens compliance with NFR‑001.

SC‑002 requires the system to output a p‑value for the correlation between visual‑complexity metrics and NASA‑TLX scores. Task T054 only computes Pearson correlation and writes a CSV; it does not compute or record the associated p‑value, thus dropping an acceptance criterion.

Task T011a claims to recruit n=20 participants via a Prolific API but includes an unresolved claim placeholder for platform details. The specification mandates a concrete recruitment mechanism; the unresolved claim leaves the recruitment requirement under‑specified, effectively weakening the functional requirement for pilot cohort acquisition.
